aws-quickstart/cd-test.readme_excerpt: **Task: Partner Developer** 1) Plan you architecture - *Resolve Issue #1* Paste in Architecture Diagram into Issue #1 in repo 2) Add submodule to Repo - *Resolve Issue #2* Add submodules for QuickStart foundational asset (VPC/Bastion/EKS/RDS/etc) see list here 3) Setup local development env - *Resolve Issue #3* Install taskcat and test initial commit (Install video/docs here) 4) Push initial commit commit (Follow automated feedback) Open issues as needed and iterate.

aws-quickstart/cloudwatch-alarm-macro.readme_excerpt: Now Supports CloudFormation Conditions CloudFormation Macro that will append a set of CloudWatch alarms for supported resources. Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2), load balancers, Lambda, and Network address translation (NAT) gateways To use the macro, add the following line to the top of your templates: Transform: AlarmMacro A sample template has been provided in /samples If you are deploying a serverless template please ensure you list this macro after the serverless transform Transform: ["AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31", "AlarmMacro"]

aws-quickstart/qs-cfn-lint-rules.name: qs-cfn-lint-rules
aws-quickstart/qs-cfn-lint-rules.readme_excerpt: This repo provides CloudFormation linting rules specific to AWS Quick Start guidelines, for more information see the Contributors Guide. cd ~/ git clone https://github.com/aws-quickstart/qs-cfn-lint-rules.git cd qs-cfn-lint-rules pip install -e . To add the rules when running on the command line use the `-a` flag to add the additional rules: cfn-lint my-cfn-template.yaml -a ~/qs-cfn-lint-rules/qs_cfn_lint_rules/ To use in your IDE install the relevant cfn-lint config file (`~/.cfnlintrc`) as follows: append_rules: - ~/qs-cfn-lint-rules/qs_cfn_lint_rules/ **Add to `syntastic` and `vim-cfn` your `~/.vimrc`:** __Add to vundle plugin section:__ "---------------------------=== CloudFormation ===------------------------------ Plugin 'scrooloose/syntastic' " Syntax checking plugin for Vim Plugin 'speshak/vim-cfn' "CloudFormation syntax checking/highlighting vim +PluginInstall
readme_headings: Vim Specfic Instructions (using vundle and syntastic)
